title: Artificial Intelligence
content:
# Artificial Intelligence

Artificial intelligence is a field of computer science
concerned with creating systems capable of performing
tasks that normally require human intelligence.

Machine learning and deep learning are important areas
within artificial intelligence.

AI is used in computer vision, natural language processing,
robotics and recommendation systems.

title: Computer Networks
content:
# Computer Networks

A computer network is a collection of interconnected
computing devices that communicate with each other.

Networks use communication protocols such as TCP/IP.

Routers, switches and access points are common networking
devices.

Computer networks can be classified as LAN, MAN and WAN.

title: Electric Vehicles
content:
# Electric Vehicles

An electric vehicle is a vehicle powered by one or more
electric motors.

Electric vehicles generally use rechargeable batteries
to store electrical energy.

Important components include the battery pack, electric
motor, inverter and charging system.

title: Laptops
content:
# Laptops

A laptop is a portable personal computer designed to be
used in different locations.

A laptop typically contains a processor, RAM, storage,
display, keyboard and battery.

Laptops are commonly used for programming, education,
business and entertainment.

title: Okf Sample Knowledge
content:
# Okf Sample Knowledge

##1

Computer Networks and TCP
Introduction
Computer networks allow devices to communicate and exchange data. A network may contain computers,
routers, switches, servers, and other devices.
TCP
Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is a transport-layer protocol that provides reliable, connection-oriented
communication. TCP uses sequence numbers, acknowledgements, retransmission, and flow control to
deliver data reliably.
IP
Internet Protocol (IP) is responsible for addressing and routing packets between networks. IPv4 uses 32-bit
addresses, while IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses.
DNS
The Domain Name System (DNS) translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses. DNS uses
records such as A, AAAA, CNAME, and MX records.
Test Keywords
This document intentionally contains the terms: TCP, reliable communication, sequence numbers,
acknowledgement, IP address, routing, DNS, domain name, and network.

title: Smartphones
content:
# Smartphones

A smartphone is a mobile computing device that combines
mobile telephone functionality with computing capabilities.

Modern smartphones commonly include a processor, RAM,
internal storage, camera, display, battery and wireless
communication capabilities.

Samsung, Apple and Google are examples of companies that
manufacture smartphones.
